messages:
oliver: FYI saw an NPE in routing when a customer pushed a flag whose value was an array instead of object. stack points at config.apply path.
rhea: omg, same tenant that tried the new plugin metadata. we let free-form JSON through. any quick hotfix ideas?
jordan: pushed a guard that rejects non-object types for that flag key and returns 422. infra-bot: alert #ALRT-772 opened for config-type-mismatch.
sam: we need a coherent safety model. proposal: typed config contracts attached to flags + console pre-apply lint + graceful runtime fallbacks.
tara: agree. From UX: show inline schema errors in console and a one-click revert for the immediate rollback. Also surface which downstream services will validate the config.
oliver: migration concerns 14. If we start requiring schemas, old values may fail. suggest three modes: "monitor" (dry-run logs), "staged-enforce" (apply but route failing requests to default), and "strict" (reject apply).
rhea: add telemetry: emit config.schema.dryrun.violation with org_id, config_id, sample payload. console can show % of org traffic that would be affected.
jordan: runtime: add a schema cache in each service so validation is cheap. if validation fails at runtime route to "safe_variant" and increment a node-local counter. Also add a health signal if fallback rate > threshold.
sam: API changes: POST /flags/:id/schema, GET /flags/:id/schema (current), GET /flags/:id/schema/history, POST /flags/:id/validate-payload. Add header X-Flag-Dryrun: true for server validation calls.
tara: console should offer "auto-generate schema from current value" with an editable suggestion. most users will expect that. show a preview of the generated schema and highlight assumptions.
oliver: technical: choose schema format. JSON Schema v2020-12 seems pragmatic. It's supported in our stack. we'll store schema as JSON string and version at commit time.
rhea: security & rate limits: schema uploads must be ACL-checked, virus-scanned, and rate-limited (per-org limit 5/min by default). infra-bot: policy recorded: schema-upload-rate > 10/min -> create alert ALRT-773.
jordan: rollout plan: week 0 internal alpha with monitor-only mode and telemetry; week 2 invite a few trusted customers with opt-in; week 4 enable monitor-by-default; week 8 staged-enforce for orgs passing thresholds; week 12 strict-enforce available by toggle.
sam: enforcement thresholds proposal: <0.05% dryrun failure rate across a rolling 7 day window and <2 orgs with >0.5% failures. show a pass/fail indicator on the console rollout page.
tara: canary UX: allow percentage-based enforcement and tenant-list targeting. console to compute projected affected tenants and traffic before apply.
oliver: implementation tasks: 1) add schema field to flag definition model 2) JSON Schema validator lib in services 3) schema cache invalidation hooks on commit 4) console lint + preview 5) telemetry counters and audit events.
rhea: backward compatibility: support an "openProperties" flag on schema to allow extra keys (good for plugin metadata). default is closed.
jordan: infra checklist: bump serde libs, add unit tests for schema validator, add fallback route for failing validations, and instrument fallback counters for alerts.
sam: docs & SDKs: add local validation helpers in our node and python SDKs, plus a migration guide and example incompatible change demo. Tara will mock the console flows and sample error text.
tara: will create figma mocks and sample error copy: "Schema mismatch: expected object with fields x,y; received array". Include link to quick-fix steps.
oliver: followups: oliver -> create RFC and timeline, jordan -> schema cache + validator, tara -> console mocks and sample messaging, rhea -> telemetry + alerts, sam -> coordinate SDK helpers.
infra-bot: ALRT-772 resolved: guard-reject deployed cluster-wide.
rhea: one more ask: add an API to preview which services will validate a given flag (helps plugin teams). GET /flags/:id/preview-validators?payload=... returns service-list and expected verdict.
sam: good call. add to RFC. i'll draft PR today and attach example schemas.
jordan: i'll start the serde bump branch now.
tara: will post figma link in a follow-up message. :thumbsup:
oliver: thanks all. this should stop noisy prod panics and make schema changes much less risky.
